{{Quote|My resupplies never arrived. No doubt Minister Shareis felt Lord Adraas, or some other dilettante, should be well armed for another needless inspection tour. Through his incompetence, the Empire is losing its hold on the systems we have only just secured.|Darth Malgus, on Shareis|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Shareis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as the [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|War Minister]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. After the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] led an [[Battle of Ord Radama|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]], Malgus' forces were not resupplied and Malgus subsequently sent Shareis some requests for resources. However, Shareis did not respond to Malgus and he failed to send the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] any supplies.<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side" />
